reviews.x: I’ve never had problems with face wipes/sensitive skin on my face in the past, but these wipes left my face looking & feeling absolutely fried. I used them pretty regularly for at least two weeks before this reaction occurred, and had not changed anything in my skin/body care routine to constitute this kind of burning reaction. I have not bought this product since then, and hope that others can avoid this kind of reaction!❤️😬

These make my face turn beet red and make its feel veryyy hot. I have never had problems with any other brand of makeup wipes, ever. I never even buy hypoallergenic ones so its a big surprise to me that i am reacting this way.

While I LOVE the wipes themselves, the “new look” packaging is terrible! They took away the plastic flip top cover, which which made it easy to get the wipes out, and now there’s just a sticky flap on the top. It’s glued on so tight I couldn’t get it off and ended up tearing the bottom apart, taking all the wipes out and putting them on a zip lock bag. Sometimes “new” is not better! Please bring back the flip top cover.

They smell great tho! If you dont have extremely sensitive skin they could work, but they weren't completely hypo allergenic. I use their face masks and have never had a problem except with the charcoal ones. Very sad I got the results I did with these wipes.

reviews.t: Great for me and a good deal
reviews.x: I was surprised to see the reports of redness from some other reviewers but pictures don’t lie. I’ve been using these for years, one or two every day. They work great for taking off my eye makeup at night and refreshing my skin in the morning. I have acne prone skin and they do not break out or dry out my face.  The two-pack price is great too since these cost around $7 for one locally.

These are absolutely horrible and left my face burning, I’ve never had a problem with make up wipes in the past. I just wanted to try something new and they claim to be for sensitive skin but no they burn my face

The Yes To Cucumbers Facial Wipes are the best I have used, and I've tried many brands.  I will not use facial wipes that don't have the plastic cap that snaps back on because they dry out, (big waste of money).  This product has the correct packaging that I want and these don't dry out.  Secondly, they are soothing, and do not have a yucky smell.........plus they don't seem to leave any residue behind on your skin.  Thank you for carrying these!

I love these wipes as I have been using them for a couple of years. They are great for my combination skin and are very soft. The convenience of using a wipe is particularly good for traveling, which I do often, because you don't have to worry about spills. I buy the 30-count packs for my house, but they also sell them in convenient packs of 10 for the purpose of traveling, which I also buy and keep in my travel cosmetic case.

reviews.t: Great wipes! New packaging, not so great…
reviews.x: I’ve used these wipes for a while now and really like them. The new packaging, however, is not great. The flap covering the opening doesn’t seal and the wipes dry out. Go back to the old packaging please!! Seriously…rethink the packaging or I will find new wipes.
These slightly stung and made my skin red and irritated. Not hypoallergenic at all. Why is there fragrance added and marketed as hypoallergic?

reviews.t: Effective and good for older, sensitive skin
reviews.x: I’ve been using these particular makeup wipes for a few years now and really like them. I’ve tried some of the other “Yes” wipes and always return to Cucumber. Not only do they remove makeup but they also provide a mild exfoliant effect. The reason for deducting a star is that my latest shipment has an issue with the closure of the packaging.

reviews.t: Takes all of your makeup off
reviews.x: They’re very soft but also very sturdy. Only need one to take off my makeup before I wash my face with Biore witch hazel face wash that leaves my face feeling very clean(I buy this on Amazon as well).
I always repurchase because these are the best priced makeup wipes that do the job. They aren't amazing, but they're pretty darn good.

I order the Yes to Cucumbers face wipes because I’ve used other yes to products in the past without issue and I was tired of washing my face like I was in a neutrogena commercial. About a minute after I used one, I noticed my face had a tingling/burning sensation. My face had turned very red and I ended up rinsing my face and keeping a cold, wet towel there for the pain.  I don’t have sensitive skin and had never had a reaction like this. I will be returning the face wipes due to this poor exper

I was at Whole Foods recently & I bought "Say Yes to Cucumbers" facial wipes for sensitive skin. I only bought one to try. Now, I'm buying more through Amazon. The online price is a little cheaper. I haven't used them on my eyes; only on my face. I'm happy to report that I haven't experienced any adverse reaction; no burning, no stinging, no redness. These wipes do not contain oils, SLS, petroleum, parabens or silicones!!!

I keep one pack in each bathroom and in my room on my nightstand. It is so wonderful to be able to grab a wipe at the end of a hard day. Pro tip: if you eye make up is particularly strong… wet the wipe a little. Don’t rub, apply gentle pressure and wiggle gently then wipe. This will cause less irritation when your eyes are feeling sensitive or when you have used more waterproof makeup.

I love these wipes. I have sensitive skin, so I have to be careful what I buy. These are good at removing makeup and cleaning my face without leaving my skin red or itchy. The scent is mild. claims.text: Several reviewers report redness, burning, or irritation, saying the wipes are not suitable for sensitive skin despite hypoallergenic claims.
Many reviewers strongly dislike the new packaging, saying the flap is hard to open and doesn't seal, causing wipes to dry out.
Some reviewers praise the wipes as gentle and effective for their skin, including sensitive and acne-prone skin.
A few reviewers mention the cucumber scent, with some finding it pleasant and others finding it heavily scented.

qa.q: Are these wipes good for sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: several say the wipes are gentle and suitable for sensitive skin [1][2][3], but one reviewer reports their face burning despite the sensitive-skin claim [4].

claims.text: The wipes are good for sensitive skin and don't leave skin red or itchy.
They are soothing and caused no reaction on very sensitive skin.
They are gentle on sensitive and combination skin.
One reviewer says the wipes burned their face despite claiming to be for sensitive skin.

qa.q: Do they remove waterproof makeup well?
qa.answer: Reviews are mixed on makeup removal: some say they remove makeup well [2][4], while another says they are not super effective for makeup removal [1]. None of the reviews specifically address waterproof makeup.

claims.text: Some reviewers say the wipes remove makeup well.
One reviewer says the wipes are not super effective for makeup removal.

qa.q: Do they have a strong smell?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on the smell: one calls it "very heavily scented" [1], another says it "isn't over scented but it is pronounced and it does linger" [2], and another says it does "not have a yucky smell" [4].

claims.text: One reviewer found the wipes very heavily scented.
Another reviewer said the cucumber scent isn't over scented but is pronounced and lingers on the skin.
Another reviewer said the wipes do not have a yucky smell.

qa.q: Are the wipes thick and durable or do they tear easily?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the wipes as thick enough and not prone to rolling up [2], but no review directly addresses durability or tearing of the wipes themselves; one review mentions tearing the packaging, not the wipes [6].

claims.text: The wipes are described as thick enough and not rolling up during use.
One review mentions tearing the packaging, not the wipes.

qa.q: Is this a good value for a pack of 2?
qa.answer: Yes, one reviewer says the two-pack price is great since a single pack costs around $7 locally [3].

claims.text: The two-pack price is great since these cost around $7 for one locally.
